exposure: Healthy term neonates (37-41 weeks gestation) between 24 and 48 hours after birth
outcome: Oxygen saturation profiles (SpO2 measured as percentage time in five intervals: <=80%, 81-84%, 85-89%, 90-94%, 95-100%)
cohort: The study included 75 healthy term neonates born at 37 to 41 weeks of gestation, monitored for 8 hours between 24 and 48 hours of life.
finding: The median SpO2 was 95.4%, with the majority of time (67.3%) spent in the 95-100% interval, and nearly one-quarter (24%) of newborns spending the highest percentage of time in the 90-94% SpO2 interval.
followup_time: 48 hours after birth (end of the 8-hour monitoring window within the 24-48 hour postnatal period)
